arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, subprocess, resource, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import worstnnz
r = worstnnz.gen(777)
open('/app/work/wn.jsonl','w').write(json.dumps(r)+"\n")
q = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','''
import resource, subprocess, sys, time
data=open("/app/work/wn.jsonl","rb").read()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("peak child RSS MiB %.1f  wall %.2fs  out %d bytes"%(u.ru_maxrss/1024.0, time.time()-t0, len(p.stdout)))
'''], capture_output=True)
print(q.stderr.decode()[:300], q.stdout.decode()[:200])
PYEOF
